title: Meeting convex regions
notes: Keep one adult at each table to read and record while children choose groups and placements. The middle return route, the three-dot pages P6-7, is marked on guide p. 3; they can also follow the game (P2) directly. Other return choices: K-1 can replay the games (P2 or P3), then add the three-label crosses question (P5) when ready; the dots-in-a-row page (P6) is optional for K-1. Grades 4-5 can use saved splits to examine coincident labels and multiple winners (P4-5), then make the all-arrangements, three-dot and minimum-number arguments (P6-8). Keep the two regions filled and the shared point explicit.
